---
title: Reactive notebooks
---


The `biblissima` repository includes marimo notebooks to explore the data gathered using the `biblissima` package.

- `marimo/browsetexts.py`: browse text groups and works to find illustrated manuscripts containing those works.
- `marimo/browsecollections.py`: browse collections of manuscripts to find texts in those collections, and illustrated manuscripts containing those texts.

For each illustrated manuscript, the notebooks provide links to:

- full record on the Biblissima portal
- an image viewer for viewing and citing the published images
